ZeroizingSecret depends on zeroize 1.8 (best-effort drop-zeroing via the crate's volatile-write strategy). The Rust compiler can in principle optimize away the Drop-side writes; the zeroize crate uses asm! barriers to prevent that. For HSM-grade guarantees the eventual KMS adapter must hold material in HSM-attested handles rather than heap Vec<u8>. Captured in P08-kms scope when that reconciliation lands.
